activation_collection.answer_policy: template prompt then answer without special tokens; no appended EOS
activation_collection.chat_policy: native history or one user message; add_generation_prompt=True
activation_collection.generic_policy: direct tokenization with tokenizer defaults; no chat template
activation_collection.key_policy: mean selected positions within each record, then L2 normalize; one key per record; duplicates retained
activation_collection.truncation_policy: right truncate to max_length; fail if no shifted positions survive

claim_boundary: Each float32 selected matrix delta has zero first-order action on its sampled clean retain basis up to recorded tolerance. This does not prove end-to-end behavioral retention, because earlier projected layers change later inputs and discarded PCA directions are unprotected. Behavioral screens remain mandatory.
